### `r date_bio_monthly`

<style>
  .superbigimage{
      overflow-x:scroll;
      white-space: nowrap;
  }
  .superbigimage img{
     max-width: none;
  }
</style>

```{r}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE)

#*******************************************************************************
# get filenames

file_biov2_monthly <- paste0(path,biov2_file,"monthly_",date_bio_monthly,".rda")
file_biov2_8day <- paste0(path,biov2_file,"8day_",date_bio_8day,".rda")
file_biov2_daily_8day <- paste0(path,biov2_file,"daily_",date_bio_daily_8day,".rda")
file_biov2_daily_month <- paste0(path,biov2_file,"daily_",date_bio_daily_month,".rda")


#*******************************************************************************
# read input data

# get biov2 pp and variables
load(file_biov2_monthly)
vec_biov2_month <- as.numeric(rda_output$PP)
rast_biov2_month = var_to_rast(rda_output %>% dplyr::select(bin, PP), ext=c(xlims,ylims))
rast_biov2_month_chl = var_to_rast(rda_output %>% dplyr::select(bin, chl), ext=c(xlims,ylims))
rast_biov2_lat = var_to_rast(rda_output %>% dplyr::select(bin, lat), ext=c(xlims,ylims))
rast_biov2_bathy = var_to_rast(rda_output %>% dplyr::select(bin, bathy), ext=c(xlims,ylims))
rast_biov2_8day = rast_biov2_8day_chl = list()
vec_biov2_8day <- list()
for (j in 1:length(file_biov2_8day)) {
    load(file_biov2_8day[j])
    vec_biov2_8day[[j]] <- as.numeric(rda_output$PP)
    rast_biov2_8day[[j]] <- var_to_rast(rda_output %>% dplyr::select(bin, PP), ext=c(xlims,ylims))
    rast_biov2_8day_chl[[j]] <- var_to_rast(rda_output %>% dplyr::select(bin, chl), ext=c(xlims,ylims))
}
vec_biov2_8day <- do.call(c, vec_biov2_8day)
rast_biov2_daily = list()
for (j in 1:length(file_biov2_daily_8day)) {
    load(file_biov2_daily_8day[j])
    rast_biov2_daily[[j]] <- var_to_rast(rda_output %>% dplyr::select(bin, PP), ext=c(xlims,ylims))
}

# get daily PP vectors for density plot
vec_biov2_daily <- list()
for (j in 1:length(file_biov2_daily_month)) {
    load(file_biov2_daily_month[j])
    vec_biov2_daily[[j]] <- as.numeric(rda_output$PP)
}
vec_biov2_daily <- do.call(c, vec_biov2_daily)

```


#### Monthly average daily PP

```{r, fig.height=4, fig.width=4}
make_raster_map(set_lims(rast_biov2_month, col_limits_pp), col_limits=col_limits_pp) + theme(plot.margin=unit(c(0,0,0,0),"mm"))
```


<br>

##### 8day average daily PP, and % difference from monthly average

Note that the %error - chla correlation coefficient here was calculated using the monthly chla.  

```{r}
pp_rasts <- lapply(rast_biov2_8day, set_lims, lims=col_limits_pp) %>% raster::stack()
names(pp_rasts) <- date_bio_8day
p1 <- make_raster_map(pp_rasts, col_limits=col_limits_pp) + theme(plot.margin=unit(c(0,0,0,0),"mm"))
p2 <- arrange_maps(rast_biov2_month, xlims, rast_biov2_8day, date_bio_8day, col_limits_pdiff, rast_biov2_month_chl, rast_biov2_lat, rast_biov2_bathy)
```

```{r, fig.height=7.5, fig.width=8}
layout <- "A
           A
           B
           B
           B"
p1 / p2 + plot_layout(design=layout)
```


<br>

#### 8day average daily PP

```{r, fig.height=4, fig.width=4}
make_raster_map(rast_biov2_8day[[2]], title=date_bio_8day[2], col_limits=col_limits_pp)
```

<br>

##### Daily PP, and % difference from 8day average

Note that the %error - chla correlation coefficient here was calculated using the 8day chla.  

```{r, fig.height=4, fig.width=12}
pp_rasts <- lapply(rast_biov2_daily, set_lims, lims=col_limits_pp) %>% raster::stack()
names(pp_rasts) <- date_bio_daily_8day
p1 <- make_raster_map(pp_rasts, col_limits=col_limits_pp, nrow=1) + theme(plot.margin=unit(c(0,0,0,0),"mm"))
p2 <- arrange_maps(rast_biov2_8day[[2]], xlims, rast_biov2_daily, date_bio_daily_8day, col_limits_pdiff, rast_biov2_8day_chl[[2]], rast_biov2_lat, rast_biov2_bathy, nrow=1)
```
<div class="superbigimage">
```{r, fig.height=7.5, fig.width=16}
p1 / p2 + plot_layout(design=layout)
```
</div>

<br>

##### Summary

Density plot of PP generated in the Northwest Atlantic using monthly, 8day, or daily input.  

```{r fig.width=8, fig.height=4}

pp_df <- data.frame(Input=c(rep("monthly",length(vec_biov2_month)),
                            rep("8day",length(vec_biov2_8day)),
                            rep("daily",length(vec_biov2_daily))),
                    PP=c(vec_biov2_month, vec_biov2_8day, vec_biov2_daily))

p <- ggplot(pp_df) +
  geom_density(aes(PP, fill=Input), alpha=0.4) +
  scale_x_log10() +
  labs(x="Primary production (daily average, mg C / m^2 / day)") +
  theme_bw() +
  theme(axis.title.y=element_blank())
print(p)
```
